findings.body: Raise: Gate — The allowance says this is one Claude-defaults correction without an interface change. The diff also adds coordinator guidance about board rows, roadmap merges, retained start tags and behind-default merges in src/forge/templates/skill.md. Separately, src/forge/review.py stops honoring the documented [models.review] setting for existing clients, changing that setting's behavior. Those changes exceed the recorded reason for the allowance.
findings.title: Recorded allowance does not match the whole change

findings.body: Raise: Not done — The changed guide paragraph says a client user-facing task uses [models.design.claude] even with workers = "codex". In src/forge/repo.py:504-505, that setting selects Codex and [models.design.codex] for every task; the changed test_design_route.py:15-16 explicitly confirms this routing. A client following the guide would edit the wrong model entry and would not get the promised Claude worker.
findings.title: Guide promises Claude for Codex-only user-facing work

why: When Claude implements or plan-reads, Forge's defaults use Opus, but the owner wants Claude implementation (build, fix, lite and design, frontend included) and plan reads on Sonnet at xhigh effort by default (2026-10-09)
